from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single paper document regarding its relationships."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper found in this document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of other papers in the collection that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted paper data from the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
